DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この列の収穫が済んだら、かごを出す前に色を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: After finishing this row's harvest, check the colors before sending the baskets out.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一つだけまだ黄色いトマトが入っています。赤い物と一緒に出してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 黄色いトマトが混ざったと報告し赤い物と出せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: There is one tomato still yellow in here. May I send it with the red ones?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Report a mixed-in yellow tomato and ask whether it can go with red ones. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それはこのかごには入れません。まず傷がないか見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: It doesn't belong in this basket. First, could you show me whether it has any damage?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 表面は傷ついていませんが、へたの近くも黄色いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 傷はないがへた付近も黄色いと状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: The surface isn't damaged, but it is yellow near the stem too.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Describe no damage but yellow coloring near the stem too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 熟し具合を確認する物として分けましょう。あちらの空のかごに入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's separate it for a ripeness check. Put it in that empty basket.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 空のかごが二つあります。札の付いていないほうを使うのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二つの空かごのうち札のない物を使うのか確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: There are two empty baskets. Do I use the one without a tag?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check whether to use the untagged one of two empty baskets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 札のないほうです。私が確認するまで、出荷用のかごとは離して置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: The untagged one. Keep it separate from dispatch baskets until I check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 分けたかごには、未確認だとわかる札も付けたほうがよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 未確認のトマトに識別用の札を付けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Should the separated basket also have a tag showing it is unchecked?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether to attach an identification tag for the unchecked tomato. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: そうですね。「確認待ち」と書いた札を付けましょう。ほかにも色の薄い物があれば知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. Let's attach a tag saying awaiting check. Tell me if you see any other pale ones.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 確認待ちの札を付けて、残りのかごにも薄い色の物がないか見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 確認待ちの札を付け残りも色を点検すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll attach the awaiting-check tag and inspect the remaining baskets for pale tomatoes too.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Attach the waiting tag and inspect the remaining colors. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 助かります。収穫に戻る前に声をかけてくださいね、お疲れ様です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: That helps. Speak to me before returning to harvesting. Thank you for your work.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お取り寄せの問題集が届いています。ご注文のお名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Your ordered workbook has arrived. What name was the order under?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: グエンです。日本語の問題集を頼んだのですが、表紙に旧版と書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 注文名を伝え問題集の表紙が旧版だと指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Nguyen. I ordered a Japanese workbook, but the cover says old edition.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Give the order name and point out the workbook's old-edition cover. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: グエン様ですね。ご注文の控えを見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Nguyen, then. May I see your order receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この控えです。注文するときは、改訂版を希望したつもりでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 注文控えを見せ改訂版を希望したつもりだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Here it is. When ordering, I thought I had requested the revised edition.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Show the order record and explain that you intended to request the revision. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 控えには旧版の番号が入っています。改訂版をご希望でしたら在庫を調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: The record has the old edition's number. If you want the revision, I'll check stock.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 受け取る前に確認したいです。改訂版は音声をスマートフォンで聞ける物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 受取前に改訂版のスマートフォン用音声を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to check before collecting it. Is the revised edition one whose audio I can listen to on a smartphone?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check smartphone audio for the revised edition before collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 商品説明では音声をダウンロードする版ですね。旧版は付属のディスクを使う説明になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: The description says its audio is downloadable. The old edition is described as using an included disc.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 家にディスクを使える機械がないので、改訂版に注文を変更できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: ディスク機器がないため改訂版への注文変更を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I don't have equipment at home that plays discs. Can I change the order to the revised edition?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request a change to the revised edition because you have no disc-playing equipment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 変更の扱いと取り寄せ日数を確認します。まだお会計はせず、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll check the change policy and ordering time. Don't pay yet; please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 支払いを待って、変更できるかと届く日を聞いてから受け取りを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 変更可否と到着日を聞くまで支払いと受取を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll hold off paying and decide about collection after hearing whether the change is possible and when it would arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Wait to pay and collect until the change possibility and arrival date are known. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承りました。こちらの椅子へどうぞ、お待ちいただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Certainly. Please take this chair, and thank you for waiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 三本の線を書けましたね。どの線がいちばん難しかったですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: You've written three lines. Which was hardest?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 真ん中の線が右に寄ってしまいました。筆を動かす向きが違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 真ん中の線が右に寄ると伝え筆の動く向きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: The middle line drifted to the right. Am I moving the brush in the wrong direction?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain the middle line drifts right and ask about brush direction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 向きだけでなく、紙の位置も見ましょう。体の正面に紙を置いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's look at paper position as well as direction. Is the paper directly in front of your body?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 紙を少し右に置いていました。真ん中に動かしてから書き直してみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 紙が右にあったと説明し正面に直して書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I had it a little to the right. I'll move it to the center and try writing again.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain the paper was rightward and move it in front before rewriting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: いいですね。今度は筆先を見るだけでなく、線の終わりの位置も意識してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Good. This time, think about where the line ends as well as watching the brush tip.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 終わりまで一気に引くのですか。それとも、途中で止めて向きを確かめますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 線を一気に引くか途中で止めるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Should I draw all the way to the end in one movement, or stop partway to check the direction?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether to draw continuously or stop midway. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まずはゆっくり一筆で引いてみましょう。私が横で手の動きを見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: First try slowly in one stroke. I'll watch your hand from beside you.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 三本とも書く前に、真ん中の線だけ別の紙で練習してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 三本を書き直す前に真ん中の線だけ練習したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Before writing all three, may I practice just the middle line on another sheet?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask to practice only the middle line before rewriting all three. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: もちろんです。練習用の紙をこちらに置きますね。納得できたら一枚に三本を書きましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Of course. I'll put practice paper here. Once you're satisfied, write three lines on one sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 別の紙でまっすぐ引く感覚をつかんでから、「川」を一枚に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 別紙で直線を練習してから「川」を一枚に書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll get a feel for drawing straight on a separate sheet, then write the character for river on one sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Practice straight lines separately before writing the character for river on one sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 焦らず試してください。それでは、練習を楽しんでくださいね。

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その小鉢は二つで一組にすることもできます。いくつお求めですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Those small bowls can also make a set of two. How many would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 同じ形を二つください。電車で帰るので、重ねずに包んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 小鉢二つを電車で運ぶため重ねずに包んでほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Two of the same shape, please. I'm going home by train, so could you wrap them without stacking them?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request two small bowls wrapped without stacking for train transport. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一つずつ紙で包んで、間に緩衝材を入れましょう。手提げ袋も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's wrap each in paper and put cushioning between them. Do you need a carry bag too?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: リュックに入れるつもりですが、小鉢が動かない箱はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: リュック内で小鉢が動かない箱の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I plan to put them in my backpack. Do you have a box that keeps the bowls from moving?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask for a box that prevents bowl movement in your backpack. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この小箱なら二つ入ります。中のすき間も紙で埋めますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: This small box fits two. I'll fill the gaps inside with paper too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 箱代を含めるといくらになりますか。予算は三千円までです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 予算三千円を示し箱込みの合計額を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: What is the total including the box? My budget is up to three thousand yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: State a three-thousand-yen budget and ask the boxed total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 小鉢二つが二千四百円で、箱は二百円です。合計二千六百円になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: The two bowls are twenty-four hundred yen and the box two hundred. That's twenty-six hundred total.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その金額なら箱もお願いします。上に重い物を載せないようにすればよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二千六百円で箱を頼み上に重い物を載せないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: At that price, please include the box. I should avoid putting heavy things on top, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request the box for twenty-six hundred yen and confirm no heavy items on top. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、箱がつぶれない位置に入れてください。包んだあと、中で動かないか私も確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. Put it where it won't be crushed. After wrapping, I'll also check that nothing moves inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 箱はリュックの上側に入れて、飲み物のボトルは別の袋で持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 箱をリュック上側に入れボトルを別袋で運ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll put the box at the top of my backpack and carry my drink bottle in a separate bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Put the box at the backpack top and carry the bottle separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 丁寧に運んでくださってありがとうございます。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you for transporting them carefully. Take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 串焼きをお持ちしました。こちらに置きますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Here are your grilled skewers. I'll put them here.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 三人で一本ずつ食べるつもりですが、二本しかありません。注文は三本で通っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 三人用の串が二本しかないと伝え三本の注文を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: There are three of us planning one each, but only two skewers arrived. Has the order gone through as three?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Report only two skewers for three people and check the order for three. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 伝票を確かめますね。ご注文は鶏の串焼き三本でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll check the order slip. Three chicken skewers, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、鶏を三本です。ほかの種類の串は頼んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 鶏三本でほかの種類は頼んでいないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, three chicken. We haven't ordered any other kind of skewer.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Specify three chicken skewers and no other kinds. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 伝票にも三本とあります。厨房に残り一本の状況を聞いてきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: The slip says three too. I'll ask the kitchen about the remaining one.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この二本は先に食べても構いませんか。全部そろうまで待つ必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 届いた二本を先に食べてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: May we eat these two first, or do we need to wait until all arrive?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can eat the two delivered skewers first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 先に召し上がっていただいて大丈夫です。残りの一本は焼き上がりまで五分ほどと聞きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: You may start. They told me the remaining one needs about five minutes to finish grilling.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: では二本は先に分けます。あと一本が届くとき、小皿も一枚いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二本を分けると伝え追加の小皿を一枚頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then we'll share the two first. When the last one comes, could we also have one small plate?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Share the two and request one extra small plate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 小皿は今お持ちしますね。残りの串も、焼き上がったら私がお届けします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll bring the plate now. I'll deliver the remaining skewer when it is grilled too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。小皿で分けて食べながら、残り一本を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 小皿で先に食べながら残り一本を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you. We'll share and eat using the small plate while waiting for the last skewer.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Eat from a small sharing plate while waiting for the remaining skewer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: お待たせして申し訳ありません。どうぞ先にお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-KURASHIKI-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'm sorry for the wait. Please go ahead and eat.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この畝は手で摘みます。見本の枝を一緒に見ましょう。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-01.translation: We pick this bed by hand. Let's look at the sample branch together.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 枝の先に小さい葉が三枚あります。三枚とも摘むのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 枝先の三枚の葉をすべて摘むか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are three small leaves at the branch tip. Do I pick all three?
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to pick all three leaves at the branch tip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日はこの柔らかい部分を摘み、下の大きな葉は残します。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today pick this tender part and leave the large lower leaves.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見本より葉が硬い枝もありますが、それも同じ籠に入れますか。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 硬い葉も同じ籠に入れるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-04.translation: Some branches have harder leaves than the sample. Do those go into the same basket?
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether hard leaves go in the same basket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 硬いものは摘まず、私に場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't pick hard ones; tell me where they are.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、この曲がった枝は残して、柔らかい先端だけ集めます。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 曲がった枝を残し柔らかい先端を集める方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll leave this bent branch and collect only tender tips.
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Leave the bent branch and collect tender tips. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その分け方でお願いします。摘んだ葉を強く押し込まないでください。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please sort that way. Don't press picked leaves hard into the basket.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 籠が半分ほど埋まったら、どこへ運べばいいですか。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 半分埋まった籠の運搬先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-08.translation: When the basket is about half full, where should I carry it?
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask where to take a half-full basket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 畝の端の日陰へ置いて、空の籠に替えましょう。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Put it in the shade at the end of the bed and switch to an empty basket.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日陰までの道にホースがあるので、通り道を確かめてから運びます。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ホースのある通り道を確認して運ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-10.translation: There's a hose on the path to the shade, so I'll check the route before carrying it.
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the path containing a hose before carrying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 私もホースの位置を見ておきます。では、気をつけて行ってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check the hose position too. Take care as you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 帽子を押さえていらっしゃいますね。風が強くなってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: You're holding your hat down. The wind has become stronger.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 景色を見る前に少し休みたいです。風を避けられる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 風を避けて休める場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like a short rest before looking at the scenery. Is there somewhere sheltered from the wind?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask for a sheltered resting place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 受付横の屋内に椅子があります。外のベンチは今、風が当たります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: There are chairs indoors beside reception. The outdoor bench is exposed to wind now.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 屋内からも山が見えますか。外へ出るか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 屋内から山が見えるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Can I see the mountains from indoors too? I'm undecided about going outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check whether mountains are visible indoors. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 窓から一部は見えます。無理に外へ出なくても大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: You can see part through the window. You don't need to force yourself outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まず窓から眺めます。写真を撮るとき、窓際に立ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 窓から眺める方針と窓際での撮影可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll look from the window first. May I stand near it to take a photo?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Choose window viewing and ask about photography beside the window. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 通路を空ければ構いませんが、椅子の上には立たないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: As long as you keep the passage clear, but don't stand on chairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 椅子は動かさず、通る人がいないときに一枚だけ撮ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 椅子を動かさず通行人がいない時に撮ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I won't move the chairs, and I'll take just one photo when nobody is passing.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Keep chairs in place and photograph when nobody is passing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。帰りはこの廊下を戻ると入口に出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. Following this corridor back leads to the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 風が収まるのを待たず、屋内で休んでから入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 屋内で休んでから入口へ戻る予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Rather than wait for the wind to die down, I'll rest indoors and then return to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Plan an indoor rest and then return to the entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: そのまま屋内の廊下をご利用ください。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Keep using the indoor corridor. Take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この部屋では、昔の暮らしに使った道具を展示しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: This room displays tools used in daily life long ago.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 真ん中の四角い場所は囲炉裏ですか。料理にも使ったのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 囲炉裏かどうかと料理への用途を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Is the square area in the center a sunken hearth? Was it used for cooking too?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether it is a hearth and whether it was used for cooking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。暖を取るほか、鍋を掛けて煮炊きする用途もありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. Besides warmth, people hung pots over it for boiling and cooking.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 上から下がっている棒は、鍋の高さを変えるための物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 吊るした棒が鍋の高さ調整用か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Is the rod hanging from above used to change the pot's height?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether the suspended rod adjusts pot height. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: これは自在鉤と呼びます。この模型で高さの調整を説明できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: It's called an adjustable pot hook. We can explain the height adjustment with this model.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 展示物に触らず、模型で動かし方を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 展示物に触らず説明用模型の実演を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Could you show how it moves using the model, without touching the exhibit?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request a demonstration with the explanatory model without touching the exhibit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの説明用模型なら私が動かします。天井の色にも注目してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll operate this explanatory model. Notice the ceiling's color too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 天井が黒っぽいのは古いからですか、それとも煙の影響ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 黒い天井と煙の関係を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Is the ceiling blackish because it's old, or because of the smoke?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask about the black ceiling and smoke. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この解説では、囲炉裏の煙によるすすについて紹介しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: This explanation discusses soot from the hearth's smoke.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 先に解説を読みます。撮影できるかは入口の表示を見て確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 解説を読み撮影可否を表示で確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll read the explanation first. I'll check the entrance sign to find out whether photography is allowed.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Read the explanation and check photography permission on signs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 解説の続きは隣の部屋です。どうぞごゆっくり、次の展示もお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: The explanation continues in the next room. Take your time and enjoy the next exhibit too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 振込の入力についてお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are you having trouble entering a bank transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 請求書は大家さんの名前なのに、画面には会社名が出ました。まだ送金していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 請求書と画面の名義が異なり未送金だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: The invoice is in my landlord's name, but the screen shows a company name. I haven't sent the money yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Report differing invoice and screen account names and that no money has been sent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 名義が違う理由は銀行では判断できません。振込の確定前に相手へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: The bank can't determine why the names differ. Check with the other party before confirming the transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 電話をする間、この入力画面をそのままにしておいてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 電話確認中に入力画面を残せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: May I leave this entry screen as it is while I telephone them?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether the entry screen may remain while you verify by phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 長く離れる場合は操作を終了してください。口座番号は請求書で確認し直せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: If you'll be away for long, end the operation. You can check the account number again from the invoice.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: いったん終了します。相手には会社名義の口座でよいか尋ねればいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 操作を終了し会社名義口座の可否を相手に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll end it for now. I should ask whether the company-name account is correct, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: End the operation and confirm asking the other party about the company account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。支店、口座番号、名義をまとめて照合してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. Compare the branch, account number and account name together.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 確認が取れなければ、今日の振込は見送ります。手数料もまだ発生していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 確認できなければ見送り手数料の発生状況を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: If I can't confirm it, I'll skip the transfer today. Has no fee been incurred yet either?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Skip if unconfirmed and ask whether a fee has arisen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 取引の状態を確認しますね。この画面では振込は確定していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll check the transaction status. On this screen, the transfer hasn't been confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 確定していないと分かりました。大家さんに連絡してから改めて手続きします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 未確定を理解し大家に連絡後に手続きすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: I understand it is unconfirmed. I'll contact my landlord and then start the procedure again.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Understand the unconfirmed status and proceed again after contacting the landlord. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 請求書をお忘れなく。ご確認後にまたご相談ください、本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Don't forget the invoice. Please consult again after checking. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 帯をお探しでしょうか。合わせる浴衣はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are you looking for an obi sash? Do you have the yukata you'll wear it with?

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 紺色の浴衣を持っています。自分で結びやすい帯を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 紺の浴衣に合う自分で結びやすい帯を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have a navy yukata. I'm looking for an obi that's easy to tie by myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request an easy-to-tie obi for a navy yukata. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらは柔らかい半幅帯で、結び方の見本もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: This is a soft half-width obi, and there are tying examples too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 写真では黄色が合いそうですが、実際に紺の布と並べて見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 黄色い帯と紺の実物見本の比較を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yellow looks suitable in the photo, but may I compare it alongside real navy fabric?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request comparison of the yellow sash with a real navy sample. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この紺の見本布で色合いを比べましょう。白い帯も横に置きますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's compare using this navy fabric sample. I'll put a white sash beside it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 黄色のほうが好みです。帯と結ぶ練習用の小物で五千円以内になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 黄色を選び帯と練習小物が五千円以内か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I prefer yellow. Can the sash and practice accessories come to within five thousand yen?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Choose yellow and ask whether the sash and practice accessories fit five thousand yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 値札の合計を確認します。この帯は四千円で、今日は小物なしでも結び方を試せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll check the price-tag total. This sash is four thousand, and today you can try tying without accessories too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: では帯だけにします。ほどけにくくする結び方を一度見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 帯だけを購入しほどけにくい結び方の実演を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then I'll take only the sash. Could you demonstrate once how to tie it so it doesn't come undone easily?
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Buy only the sash and request a secure tying demonstration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 見本で説明しますね。最後に端を整えるところまでゆっくり見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll explain with the sample. Watch slowly through arranging the ends at the finish.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 端の整え方が分かりました。家でも見本の写真を見ながら練習します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 端の整え方を理解し自宅で写真を参考に練習すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I understand how to arrange the ends. I'll practice at home too while looking at a photo of the sample.
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Understand arranging the ends and practice at home using the example photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 帯を包みますね。どうぞ浴衣でのお出かけを楽しんでください、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OKY-TAKAHASHI-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll wrap the sash. Enjoy going out in your yukata, and thank you.
